content.title: PENGU is the official coin of Pudgy Penguins.
content.description: Pudgy Penguins has become the face of crypto with one of the most influential communities in the industry. From large companies wearing the Penguin, to being featured in ETF commercials, to garnering millions of followers and over 100 billion views, the Pengu has become a cultural icon making PENGU the world’s social currency.

content.title: About Cardano (ADA)
content.description: Cardano is a blockchain platform built on academic research that enables smart contracts and decentralized applications while using significantly less energy than traditional cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin.

content.title: About Pi Network (PI)
content.description: Pi Network is a social cryptocurrency and developer platform designed to make digital currency mining accessible to everyday people through mobile devices.

content.title: What is Hyperliquid about?
content.description: Hyperliquid is a layer one (L1) blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Beyond its flagship DEX trading platform, the ecosystem supports borrowing, lending, real world assets (RWAs), and a full-fledged Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), making it a leading force in decentralized finance (defi).

content.title: About Bitcoin (BTC)
content.description: Bitcoin is the world's first decentralized cryptocurrency that enables peer-to-peer electronic cash transactions without intermediaries like banks or governments.

content.title: About MetaDAO (META)
content.description: MetaDAO is a decentralized fundraising and governance platform built on Solana that implements futarchy, a market-based decision-making model.

content.title: What is Wiki Cat?
content.description: Wiki Cat is a deflationary meme token designed to create a NFT club, where users can hold, buy and sell unique NFTs on a peer-to-peer platform. It was initially created by Sir. Mapy to educate the SMC DAO on creating meme tokens.The Wiki Cat community is robust, and its strength lies in the social consensus of shared value. Like Doge and Shiba Inu, Wiki Cat aims to establish a meme token ecosystem focusing on NFTs, leveraging its passionate community to achieve significant market value.

content.title: About Sui (SUI)
content.description: Sui is a Layer 1 blockchain designed for global adoption by providing a high-speed and secure environment for digital asset ownership.

content.title: What is Cosmos Hub (ATOM)?
content.description: The Cosmos network consists of many independent, parallel blockchains, called zones, each powered by classical Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) consensus protocols like Tendermint. Some zones act as hubs with respect to other zones, allowing many zones to interoperate through a shared hub.

content.title: What is UNI?
content.description: UNI is the governance token for Uniswap. UNI was introduced on 16th September 2020 through a retrospective airdrop to users who have interacted with the protocol either by swapping tokens or by providing liquidity.

content.title: What is CloneX?
content.description: CloneX is a 20,000 collection next-gen Avatars, by RTFKT and Takashi Murakami
